hooks.command: input=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in content/modules/*|*/content/modules/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cwd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty'); [ -n "$cwd" ] || cwd="$PWD"; out=$(cd "$cwd" && npm run -s tts:check -- --quiet 2>&1); code=$?; if [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then reason=$(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -5); jq -nc --arg r "$reason" '{systemMessage: ("Narration stale — " + $r)}'; fi; exit 0
